headlines.title: SpaceX, Netflix, GM, and United Airlines earnings: What to Watch
headlines.summary: Market Domination Overtime host Brooke DiPalma takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch for Tuesday, Oct. 20, including earnings reports from Netflix (NFLX), SpaceX (SPCX), General Motors (GM), and United Airlines (UAL).

headlines.title: Netflix to report; OpenAI’s reported fundraising plans - what’s moving markets
headlines.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock market futures float around the flatline, as investors prepared for an accelerating flood of corporate results and gauged the outlook for the artificial intelligence trade. Netflix and United Airlines are among the highlights of the quarterly earnings agenda, while OpenAI is reportedly racing to raise $30 billion ahead of Anthropic’s much-anticipated initial public offering.

headlines.title: Could Skydance Pose a Big Threat to Netflix's Future Growth?
headlines.summary: HBO and Paramount joining forces could give Netflix its most concerning competition yet.

headlines.title: Netflix Needs an Earnings Win to Turn the Stock Around
headlines.summary: Netflix shares are down 26% this year. It is scheduled to report fiscal third-quarter results after the stock market closes on Tuesday.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
